content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to connect an MPU speed sensor directly to the high speed counter on [product_name]? Is a signal conditioner required? If so, do you have recommendations for such modules?
Please specify the type and the name of the manufacturer. Additionally, which [product_name] do you have?

I am using the KEP AMP-1 Magnetic PickUp signal conditioner.
You haven't mentioned exactly which [product_name] you have. If your device supports fast counting inputs, these typically process up to a maximum frequency of 5 kHz.
